app.name: Desktop Organizer
common.folder_placeholder: Choose a folder or type a path
tool.file_cleaner.title: Sort files
tool.file_cleaner.desc: Sorts the files in a folder by type. Shows a preview before anything moves.
tool.backup.title: Backup
tool.backup.desc: Copies new and changed files to a destination folder and verifies the copies.
tool.password.title: Password generator
tool.notes.title: Notes
tool.notes.desc: Quick notes with tags and search.
tool.duplicates.title: Find duplicates
tool.duplicates.desc: Finds identical files by checksum. Deletes only to the Recycle Bin.
tool.system_monitor.title: System monitor
tool.system_monitor.desc: Processor, memory, battery and disks, live.
tool.text_replacer.title: Replace text
tool.text_replacer.desc: Replaces terms in many text files, with preview and backups.
tool.reminders.title: Reminders
tool.reminders.desc: One-off and recurring reminders as Windows notifications.
tool.tasks.title: Tasks
tool.tasks.desc: Task list with due dates and an optional reminder.
tool.file_sizes.title: Storage
tool.file_sizes.desc: Shows which folders use the most storage.
tool.time_tracker.title: Time tracker
tool.time_tracker.desc: Timer per project and task, weekly summary and CSV export.
tool.clipboard.title: Clipboard history
tool.clipboard.desc: Stores copied text locally. Searchable, pinnable, pausable at any time.
file_cleaner.intro: Sorts the files directly inside the chosen folder into subfolders by type. Existing subfolders are not touched. A preview is shown before anything moves.
file_cleaner.summary: {count} files will be moved. Check the list before you continue.
file_cleaner.nothing: No files to sort were found.
file_cleaner.undo_text: Move the files from the last run back to where they were?
backup.intro: Copies selected folders to a destination folder. Only new and changed files are copied. Nothing is deleted at the destination. Every copy is checked with SHA-256.
backup.no_sources: Add at least one source folder.
backup.plan_summary: New: {new}, changed: {changed}, unchanged: {unchanged}. To copy: {size}. Skipped: {errors}.
backup.done: {copied} files copied, {verified} verified, {failed} errors, {mismatched} verification failures.
password.intro: Creates passwords with a cryptographically secure random generator. Passwords are not stored.
password.copied: Copied. The clipboard is cleared in {seconds} seconds.
password.clipboard_note: After copying, the clipboard is cleared after {seconds} seconds, as long as it still holds the same password.
notes.body_placeholder: Write a note. Tags such as #project are detected.
notes.empty: No notes yet. Press Ctrl+N to start.
notes.quick_hint: Type a note and save it with Ctrl+Enter.
duplicates.intro: Finds files with identical content. Files of equal size are compared first, then their SHA-256 checksum. Checked files go only to the Recycle Bin.
duplicates.mark_extra: Check all but the first file
duplicates.deleting: Moving files to the Recycle Bin ...
duplicates.summary: {groups} groups found, {files} files checked, {wasted} used by copies. Errors: {errors}.
duplicates.confirm_text: Move {count} checked files to the Recycle Bin?
duplicates.deleted: {count} files moved to the Recycle Bin, {failed} errors.
text_replacer.intro: Replaces a text in all matching files of a folder. Check the preview first, then replace. Originals are backed up beforehand.
text_replacer.summary: {files} files with {count} matches. {scanned} text files checked, {binary} binary files skipped, errors: {errors}.
text_replacer.undo_text: Restore the files from the backed-up originals?
reminders.intro: Reminders appear as Windows notifications. Without a tray icon, a small window is shown instead.
reminders.title: Text
reminders.past: The time is in the past.
tasks.intro: Tasks with an optional due date. With a reminder, the app sends a notification at 09:00 on the due date.
tasks.title: Title
file_sizes.intro: Adds up the size of each subfolder and lists the largest first. Symbolic links are not followed.
time.intro: Timer for a project and task. Starting a new timer stops the running one.
clipboard.intro: Stores copied text on this device only. Nothing is uploaded. Password managers mark their copies as private, and those are not stored.
clipboard.status_off: Recording is paused. Nothing is stored.
clipboard.clear_text: Delete all entries that are not pinned? Pinned entries are kept.
settings.title: Settings
settings.restart_note: A changed language takes effect the next time the app starts.
settings.quick_note_shortcut: Global shortcut Ctrl+Alt+N for quick notes
settings.delete_all_note: Deletes notes, tasks, reminders, time entries, clipboard history, settings, logs and backups inside the data folder. Backups in your destination folders are kept.
settings.delete_text: Permanently delete all app data? The app will close afterwards.
settings.deleted: All data was deleted. The app will close.
